impact: Selling into Nvidia's beat signals the AI trade is still fragile, limiting the relief bounce for MU, DRAM, SNXX and NBIS; hawkish Fed minutes could extend the S&P's losing streak.
summary: Nvidia, up 3.7% premarket on its $130B guide, reversed after Wednesday's open and traded about 0.8% to 1.1% lower, as chip stocks cooled. Premarket gains in Micron (+3.4%), Nebius (+8.1%) and CoreWeave (+6.5%) faded, with Nebius up only about 1% and CoreWeave down 3% by mid-morning. By midday the Dow was down about 625 points, the S&P 500 modestly lower and the Nasdaq hovering near breakeven, ahead of the Fed minutes at 2 p.m. ET (about 96% odds of a December hike priced) and Anthropic's IPO pricing.
title: Nvidia bounce fizzles; Dow down ~625 points midday before Fed minutes
